headline: Pepkor Closes Shoe City Chain to Advance Planned 2027 Launch of PlusB Bank
summary: Pepkor closed its Shoe City retail chain as part of a strategic shift to focus on regulatory approvals for the planned 2027 launch of its PlusB bank.
why: Retailers expanding into consumer banking reallocate capital away from underperforming physical store formats to build financial services divisions.

impacts.name: Pepkor
impacts.why: Store closures and new bank venture launches shift corporate capital deployment.
